Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

Class IndexAdvice

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo.IndexAdvice
public final class IndexAdvice extends Object
Index diagnostics without an Atlas account: which indexes are actually being used, which are dead weight, and which index the query in the bar would want.

Compass shows this only through cloud-gated Performance Insights; the raw material — $indexStats usage counters and the query's own field list — is available to any client that bothers to ask. Two rules, both conservative:

  • Unused: an index whose accesses.ops is zero since the server last restarted. Reported with the counter's start time, because "unused" on a server restarted an hour ago means nothing.
  • Suggested: the equality fields of a filter first, then the sort fields — the equality-sort-range order that makes an index usable for both. Only suggested when no existing index already starts with the same fields.

Pure: it works on the documents $indexStats and listIndexes return, so the rules can be tested without a server.

      public static org.bson.Document suggestedIndex(org.bson.Document filter, org.bson.Document sort)
      The index a find would want: its equality fields, then its sort fields. Operators other than equality ($gt, $in, …) are treated as range fields and go last, which is the order that lets one index serve the filter and the sort together.
      Returns:
      the suggested key, or an empty document when the query needs no index
